description: This file defines an abstract class `AbstractUploader` for managing multipart uploads to AWS services using the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes methods for handling source streams, creating upload commands, and managing upload parts.

classes.name: AbstractUploader
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for multipart upload management with AWS services, such as creating upload parts, handling source streams, and generating upload commands.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the uploader with the client, source data, and configuration.

methods.name: limitPartStream
methods.description: Creates a stream limited to the size of a single upload part.

methods.name: getUploadCommands
methods.description: Generates and yields commands for uploading parts, handling seekable sources, and detecting EOF.

methods.name: createPart
methods.description: Abstract method to generate parameters for an upload part based on the source.

methods.name: isEof
methods.description: Checks if the source stream has reached EOF.

methods.name: determineSource
methods.description: Converts the input source into a readable stream, handling file names or stream resources.

methods.name: getNumberOfParts
methods.description: Calculates the total number of parts based on the source size and part size.
